title: AI Agents for Beverage Brands: Investigate Distributor Delivery Claims
summary: A Genie builds a sourced timeline from NetSuite, Postgres, and Gmail for a beverage delivery deduction, with time zones intact for a human decision.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A beverage delivery-claim Genie should compare the distributor’s assertion with the agreed window, shipment timeline, and receiving evidence. It can assemble a clear case for logistics and finance, preserving time zones and quantities. It should not infer delivery from dispatch or decide a chargeback solely from an unverified appointment note.


Explore the complete[beverages integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/beverages) for the systems and processes around this guide.
